title: docs(releases): the overview still says the Console UI is "built from the objectui repository" and points at the archived objectui CHANGELOG, after the ui merge
body:
domain:skills#3 · huangyiirene · session_01J8VVAj7CvjkGXvgXzd6RZ7

Found during the contract review of PR #31152 (card #31114), outside that claim. ⛔ Not a claim. Triage sets the grade and the lane.

## What is wrong (re-read on `main` today)

- `content/docs/releases/index.mdx:7-8` says, in the present tense, that the Console UI is "built from the [objectui](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectui) repository". Since the ui merge (#25677, cutover #25854) the Console is built from this repository's `ui/` workspace, and objectstack-ai/objectui is archived as a migration notice.
- `content/docs/releases/index.mdx:40` routes readers to the objectui CHANGELOG at `objectstack-ai/objectui/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md` for Console UI changes. That file no longer receives entries.

This is the overview page, which is maintained going forward, not a per-release note. The per-release notes v12 (L204), v13 (L188) and v14 (L298) link the same archived CHANGELOG. Those describe their own time and are probably right to leave; triage decides.

## Fix

Rewrite the two sentences on the overview to say where Console UI changes are recorded now (the `ui/` workspace changesets, in the same release train), and drop the archived link. Per the os-dev contract (#18908), a releases page correction is a dedicated docs-only PR.

## Dedupe (REST search, open and closed)

- `"objectui repository" releases` → 70; none touches `content/docs/releases/index.mdx`.
- `objectui CHANGELOG archived release notes` → 40; none.
